title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (2/20): Child of the Qihang
note_en: Chinese pairs 虽然 "although" with 但(是) "but" in the same sentence: 虽然他可能永远到不了那个叫"新地球"的星球，但他相信后代一定会到达. In English you'd use only one of them ("Although he might never get there, he believed..."), but in Chinese the two work as a frame, and 但(是) is normally kept. Notice also that 虽然 can come after the subject: 大东虽然也有点怀疑，但还是答应了.
